column1: # hk_activity_map.tsv -- HealthKit workout activity_type -> kit workout_types.
# Read by service/health/hk-ingest. Data, not code: the Korean category and
# subtype words are the kit's own workout_types vocabulary (workout-log
# SKILL.md dictionary), so they live here and the engine stays ASCII.
# `strength` in the 5th column of a map row marks the strength family: those
# attach to the same-day set-logged session when there is one.
# alias rows: the receiver sends `type_<raw>` when the app build does not name
# a type. The raw number is HKWorkoutActivityType's stable enum value, so a
# raw code of a type this table already names is the SAME activity and gets
# the same row -- only for the named set below. Every other type_<raw> stays
# `other`. (Measured 2026-09-26: 70 of 102 stored workouts are type_20, i.e.
# the owner's gym sessions; mapped to `other` they would never attach to the
# set-logged session and would double every gym day.)
